message.parkourmod.need_sprint: You need to be sprinting to start a burst
config.parkourmod.title: Parkour Mod — Settings
config.parkourmod.burst_seconds.tooltip: How many seconds the burst lasts.
config.parkourmod.burst_multiplier.toolt: How much faster you run at peak burst (2.0 = double).
config.parkourmod.wall_jump_speed.toolti: Horizontal speed of the jump from a cling. 0.44 is about 3-4 blocks.
config.parkourmod.cling_slide_speed.tool: Blocks per tick while clinging. Lower = slower slide.
config.parkourmod.wall_run_speed.tooltip: Multiplier relative to your approach speed. Lower = slower.
config.parkourmod.wall_run_vertical.tool: How fast you can climb/descend the wall by looking up/down. 0 = height stays constant.
config.parkourmod.camera_effects.tooltip: Enables shake, tilts and FOV changes in parkour mode.
config.parkourmod.wall_run_tilt.tooltip: How much the camera tilts while wall running.
config.parkourmod.invert_tilt.tooltip: Enable if the camera tilts the wrong way.
config.parkourmod.fov_bonus.tooltip: How many degrees the FOV widens at peak burst.
config.parkourmod.dash_jump_shift.toolti: Hold Jump + Shift to charge the dash, release to leap. Disable to charge only with the separate key (Controls → Parkour Mod).
config.parkourmod.dash_bar_seconds.toolt: Seconds for the marker to travel from section 1 to section 3. Lower = harder to hit.
config.parkourmod.dash_distance.tooltip: Approximate leap distance on flat ground.
config.parkourmod.slide_distance.tooltip: How far the player slides (Shift + Sprint while running).
message.parkourmod.slide_need_run: You need to be running to slide
config.parkourmod.run_animation.tooltip: Play the Emotecraft-based animations in parkour mode (visible in third person, F5).
config.parkourmod.run_animation_speed.to: Speed multiplier for all animations. The run step also speeds up during a sprint burst.
config.parkourmod.swap_wall_run.tooltip: Enable if the right-wall animation plays on the left wall (and vice versa).
